subject: Request: pilot window extension & goodwill credits due to integration blocker
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@meltwateranalytics.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Caitlin Ng <caitlin.ng@meltwateranalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot timeline at risk — requesting extension + credits

Hi Lukas,

Quick note from the Meltwater engineering team — our integration sprint hit an unexpected blocker with the webhook schema the vendor changed overnight. Caitlin is debugging but we just pushed our demo window by at least 10 business days.

We really want to keep the pilot on Redwood (the telemetry and KV cache behavior looked promising), but this delay means we will miss the originally booked demo and run out of sandbox capacity before we can finish end-to-end validation. Two asks:

- Can Redwood provide a 3-week extension to our pilot window?
- Would you consider a small goodwill credit (~$1,500 equivalent of sandbox capacity) so our engineers can finish testing without being throttled?

I attached the logs and our updated schedule. We can jump on a 15-min call if that helps.

Appreciate any flexibility here — Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Head of Integrations, Meltwater Analytics
[Attachment: integration_error_logs.zip (zip, 2MB)]
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@meltwateranalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline at risk — requesting extension + credits

Hi Jordan — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs.

Sorry to hear about the schema change; that kind of late-breaking change is exactly the sort of thing that derails pilots. I looped in Ben (sales) and Neha (solutions) so we can evaluate the ask quickly. A couple quick clarifying questions from our side:

- Do you expect the engineering work to be done within three weeks, or would you prefer a month to be safe?
- Is the request for $1,500 strictly for tokens/sandbox hours, or should we consider temporary priority routing for your test runs?

If you can share an ETA (Caitlin), we’ll draft an internal approval so Ben can confirm any commercial make-good. If it helps, I can schedule a 15-min sync this afternoon.

Cheers,
Lukas Meyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@meltwateranalytics.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline at risk — requesting extension + credits

Jordan — appreciate the detail and the logs.

We want Meltwater to be successful; happy to propose the following conditional make-good:

- 3-week pilot extension (no change to the existing test environment or endpoints)
- $1,500 sandbox credit applied immediately to your account for test runs
- One week of dedicated priority routing during your final validation week (to keep latency stable while you demo)

Conditions:
- We keep the current PoC scope and core model pinned to v1.3 during the extension window.
- Meltwater confirms acceptance by end-of-day Friday (2025-11-07) so we can provision the credits and routing.

If you sign off, I’ll issue the credit and update the PoC timeline on HubSpot. Neha — can you confirm the routing window logistics if they accept?

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/MW-2025-0421]
From: Caitlin Ng <caitlin.ng@meltwateranalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@meltwateranalytics.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@meltwateranalytics.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline at risk — requesting extension + credits

Hi Ben / Lukas — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We ran a quick triage and expect the webhook schema incompatibility to be resolved inside ~10 business days. Three weeks is safe. Meltwater accepts the three-week extension and the $1,500 sandbox credit. We also appreciate the week of priority routing; that will help stabilize the demo metrics.

Action items from our side:
- Confirm new demo date: target week of Nov 24 (tentative)
- Procurement: please send any short acceptance note we need to sign so accounting can track the credit.

We attached an updated PoC schedule.

Thanks — Caitlin
Caitlin Ng
Platform Engineer, Meltwater Analytics
[Attachment: poc-schedule-v2.xlsx (xlsx, 25KB)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caitlin Ng <caitlin.ng@meltwateranalytics.com>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@meltwateranalytics.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline at risk — requesting extension + credits

Thanks all — great to hear. Confirming Redwood will:

- Apply a $1,500 sandbox credit to the Meltwater trial account (visible in Billing > Credits within 24 hours).
- Extend the pilot by 3 weeks from the original end date; new target demo week: Nov 24 (we’ll keep this flexible if you need the last week of Nov).
- Enable priority routing for the final validation week (Nov 17–23) — Neha, please set up the routing policy and share the warm-up checklist.

Jordan / procurement — if you can reply with a one-line confirmation ("Meltwater accepts the credit and extension") we’ll mark the deal and push the changes. Attachments and HubSpot updated.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
